title: Rustic Living
description: Designed around adding things realted to the rustic farming life.
body:
While the initial release version contains no recipes, each crop plant and item was picked for their common use in rustic recipes.

The Farming Claw, Pitchfork, Rake, Scythe, and Stonebow help you establish, maintain, and defend your farm.
Cabinet and Shelf storage blocks made from each of the vanilla wood types. Shelves come with and without jars, and both types can act as a free standing ladder.
Finally, you have the Butter Churn, Cheese Press, Cutting Board, Flour Mill, and Iron Stove for decoration and added utility and in preparing ingredients for recipes.

Daub, Path, and Thatch block sets are here to add additional decoration options for structures.
Wooden Vertical Slabs, Wall Slabs, and Posts allow for adding event more depth and detail to your builds.
32 new Armor Sets are also here for you to mix and match new ways t dress up and protect yourself.
